prompt.en: In what year was Ottawa chosen as the capital of Canada?
prompt.fr: En quelle année Ottawa a-t-elle été choisie comme capitale du Canada?

explanation.en: Discover Canada dates the choice of Ottawa as the capital to 1857. The city sits on the Ottawa River.
explanation.fr: Découvrir le Canada situe en 1857 le choix d'Ottawa comme capitale. La ville se trouve sur la rivière des Outaouais.

source.quote: Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857

verification.evidence: The National Capital Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857
